areas.name: Assumption-lean inference
areas.description: Inference that rests on the single structural fact a problem cannot do without, rather than a full parametric model — and that stays honest when those extra assumptions would fail.

areas.name: Inference for AI and machine learning
areas.description: Error bars for the predictions and algorithms people actually deploy: conformal and predictive inference, and black-box tests for whether a learning procedure is stable.

areas.name: Dependent and high-dimensional data
areas.description: Inference for time series and graphical models when the number of parameters is large — including how two networks differ.

areas.name: Statistical methods for imaging
areas.description: Reconstruction and inference for medical imaging, including accelerated breast DCE-MRI.
